title: Web Dev
description: Apps, portals and tools I've built
info: I build web apps that solve a real problem for the people using them: school portals, exam-paper generators, a business website and interactive visualisations. Most are built with React / Next.js, deployed on Vercel, and developed with AI-assisted workflows. Some of my work is internal business software that can't be shared publicly, so only public demos are shown here.

title: Videos
info: Video is where I started as a creator. I've made short films, program trailers, event highlights and social media reels, and handled everything from shooting and editing to colour and motion graphics. The aim is always the same: make the audience feel what the moment felt like.

title: PHS Social Media
description: Reels made for the school's Instagram
info: Reels and posts I produced for the Panjataniyah Higher Secondary School Instagram page, covering events, activities, Hifz and student book reviews. Shot, edited and published as part of running the school's social media.

title: Designs
info: Vector graphics, layouts and visual identity work. I design with clarity first: the layout should carry the information before the decoration does.

title: Photography
info: Photography is a hobby for me, not a profession: outdoor trips, wildlife and small everyday scenes, edited in Lightroom.
